judge.voice: Fine, B1, not C1. I didn't expect that, but it quoted my own sentences back, 'supplier confirm', 'we have penalty', and I can't argue: those are real. My 'we was discussing about' and 'since 2015' were in my first answer and nobody mentioned them. Those are what the new director notices. So I trust the level, but I'd want the focus to be sharper before I commit to practising. I'd try it again, and I'd tell a colleague it's quick and honest.

conversation.title: Asking for an earlier parts delivery
conversation.goal: Ask Priya to move a parts delivery earlier and agree on a new day.

turns.text: Hi, it's Priya calling about your parts order. They're booked in for Thursday. What can I help you with today?

Hello Priya, thank you for calling. Yes, we have a quality issue on our production line and we was discussing about the delay with my team. We need the parts more early, because the stakeholder don't accept another delay. Can you deliver them on Tuesday?
Thanks, that makes the urgency clear. Tuesday is tricky, so let me check with our warehouse. Are all the parts needed by then, or only some of them?

Not all of them. We need only the one half of the parts on Tuesday, the critical one for the production line, and the rest can come on Thursday like it was planned. Is it possible to do a partial delivery?
That's clear, thank you. I'll check with the warehouse now. What would you like to receive from me once everything is settled?

I would like to receive a confirmation by email, with the exact day and the time of delivery, and also the tracking number. If the Tuesday is not possible, please tell me the earliest date what you can do. Then I repeat the new day back to you.
Yes, I can send an email with the day, time and tracking number. Tuesday is not possible, but Wednesday morning might work for you. Does that suit your line?

Yes, Wednesday morning is acceptable for us. So I repeat the new day: the delivery will be on Wednesday morning, and you send me the email with the exact time and tracking number. Please make sure the critical parts are in the first delivery, because we can't stop the line again.
Wednesday morning, with the critical parts in the first delivery, is noted. Shall I send the written details to your email today?

judge.voice: Finally a topic that's mine: a supplier, a deadline, a partial delivery. Priya sounded like a real account manager, not a sandwich shop, and nobody slowed me down. The correction on "stakeholder don't" was right and the rule was one line, fine. But I said "we was discussing about" and "more early" in the very same sentence and Linga let both pass. Later "the earliest date what you can do" also slid by. If you only fix one thing, I'm not convinced you see my real problem. It ended after four replies, which felt abrupt. I would use it again before a call, and I'd tell a colleague, but I want the recap to name my repeat errors.
